name: ponytail
tagline_zh: 纯属好玩，装了不亏：ponytail。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode — always pick the simplest solution that works. Use this skill whenever writing, refactoring, or reviewing code to keep changes minimal: prefer the standard library, native platform features, and already-installed dependencies over new code or dependencies. Trigger when the user says "ponytail", "keep it simple", "simplest thing that works", "don't over-engineer", "lazy mode",
